ideas.name: any warning calling with net liquidity's month
ideas.why: net liquidity (Fed balance sheet less Treasury cash less reverse repo) up $50bn+ over four weeks is cash looking for assets, which lifts equities; a turn calling long then (short after a $50bn drain) has that flow behind it

ideas.name: any warning while liquidity drains fast
ideas.why: net liquidity down $100bn+ in four weeks tightens funding; de-risking overshoots both ways intraday, so turns pay
